content.what_it_is: A one-page MATLAB-generated EPS figure for case C. It contains four vertically stacked time-series panels titled Gauge 6, Gauge 9, Gauge 16, and Gauge 22, each plotting eta in metres with ticks -0.05, 0, 0.05, and 0.1 against horizontal ticks 25, 30, 35, and 40; the shared bottom axis is x in metres. Each panel overlays a solid blue trace and a dashed red trace, but the EPS contains no legend naming them.
entities: MathWorks PostScript prolog and drawing procedures (lines 12-166)
